name: dsh-llm-claude-code
description: DSH host plugin: route a DSH conversation to a real Claude Code session through the Agent SDK. Bridges DSH's bash/read/write/edit/todo_write tools into the inner session (switching the native equivalents off), renders every inner tool call as a live card, maps DSH's read-only and plan modes onto the inner permission mode, and routes /compact and /goal to whichever side owns them.
